verdict.rationale: Ramp's docs explicitly describe the exact workflow: vendor invoice matched to PO, coded to GL, routed for approval, and paid (ramp-docs-2), backed by dedicated AI agents for auto-coding, fraud, approval routing, and payment (ramp-docs-17), dynamic multi-department approval routing (ramp-docs-16), ERP sync to eliminate manual journal entries (ramp-docs-5), and a documented Bill Payments API to create/approve/pay bills end-to-end (ramp-docs-23). Community evidence corroborates the broader expense/approval platform working well in practice (ramp-comm-2). Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification specifically of PO-matching accuracy/reliability at scale, and clearer detail on how invoice-to-PO matching logic handles exceptions.
